plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Big Bro reads your sleep, weight, steps, distance, flights climbed, exercise time, active energy, heart rate, HRV, breathing rate, and outdoor walk/run routes from Apple Health so your trackers stay up to date automatically.

plugins.calendarPermission: Big Bro reads events from your Apple Calendar so they show up alongside your goals, workouts, and prayer times.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Big Bro uses your location to calculate accurate Athan and Iqama prayer times for where you are.

plugins.cameraPermission: Big Bro uses your camera to capture your one photo journal entry for the day.
